item.description: Colossal Biosciences is reportedly working on a project to bring back the extinct dodo bird. The company plans to use gene-editing technology to introduce dodo traits into the cells of the Nicobar pigeon, which is the dodo's closest living… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
